title: Illustrations
slide_intent: Teach illustrators to use perspective and negative space to establish a common visual language. A reader can recognize relationships among images even when their subjects differ.
strategic_value: Slack can carry an illustration style across brand communications and product surfaces. The depicted objects and people vary while the drawings retain flat color fields and economical silhouettes.
demonstration: Four illustrations compare different subjects. Keys and a compass occupy the upper row. Hands frame a Slack mark in the larger lower image, beside a narrow drawing of a person appearing in a screen.
practical_value: Compare a new illustration with the examples for depth, silhouette and open space. The hands example shows how the unfilled center can direct attention toward the mark.

content_islands.spec: Arrange the explanation in a narrow column at left. Name perspective and negative space and direct the reader to the illustration-specific guide for detailed construction.

content_islands.spec: Group four specimens at right. Put the keys and compass on separate upper fields. Below, give the illustration of hands the widest field and place the person in a narrow vertical panel beside it. Use small gutters to preserve each composition.
